name: com.coverup.mapsdk
description: Authoring contract for Cover Up! Workshop maps: the _CoverUpMap components (MapConfig, MapSizeVariants, MapBoundsVolume, CamouflageSurface, MapSpawnDisc, WorkshopMapInfo) plus the map-size + player-scale contract. Both the shipping game and third-party map projects depend on this package, so a map bundle's component scripts bind to the game's classes by identical GUIDs. (M2 will add the Validate/Export tooling.) See Docs/MapSdk.md.
